title: Speed up exact frame algebra with pinned replay evidence
body:
PR364's full shipped verifier repeatedly computes frame ranks and canonical row-space keys with Fraction-heavy elimination. This adds a standard-library exact integer implementation and a pinned adapter that substitutes only those two helpers while running the unchanged full verifier.

A fresh local sequential A/B replay of the packaged code took **227.54 → 64.48 seconds (3.53×)**. Its four transcript stages took **200.98 → 39.08 seconds (5.14×)**. This is one CPython 3.13 pair on macOS, not a benchmark median or measured mathematical-search throughput.

Validation includes:
- Exact comparison of all 33,235 distinct B/A/Gram rank matrices and 13,847 canonical basis keys from the five original snapshots; 600 seeded rational/singular matrices, edge cases and 150 row-space invariance tests.
- The full original and optimized verifiers both passed, including the PR346 reconstruction control and official C++ checkers. All 15 transcript word/state/frame files match pinned originals byte for byte; exact pricing matches after normalizing only its output path.
- All 64 immutable source files remain unchanged. Negative controls reject tampered source, reused output directories and disabled assertions. The offline fixture is regenerated from the original full replay and compared exactly.

The 245 KB fixture, original helper source/license/notice, source/output pins, full-replay adapter, benchmark and local receipts are in `research/frame-algebra-performance/`. Dedicated CI checks Python 3.11/3.14 and performs a complete sequential A/B replay on Python 3.13.

This changes no kappa and does not complete PR364's open native admission obligations. Its optional earlier producer regeneration is outside the shipped verifier and this timing. The utility is available for other live search/checker code; frozen packages remain untouched and would require regenerated manifests/dependency pins for direct integration.

Prepared with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; original construction and Claude-assisted helper credits are retained. Apache-2.0.
